data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to open the default system file manager app on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows your app to open the native File Manager on Android (such as Downloads or Recent) or the Files app on iOS (to the app's Documents folder). You can also specify custom subdirectories or folder paths.
use_when: You want users to view downloaded files inside the system file manager
You need to open the app's documents directory directly in the iOS Files app
avoid_when: You need to pick files within your app instead of launching an external app
You require fine-grained file manipulation and reading inside Dart code
strengths: Supports opening specific folder paths on both Android and iOS
weaknesses: Limited to opening specific folders in external applications rather than file management inside the app
data.setup_notes: For iOS, you must add UISupportsDocumentBrowser to Info.plist and save at least one file to the app's Documents folder.

alternatives.name: file_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick files or directories using native UI components instead of launching the standalone file manager application.
